description: This file is the main activity for an Android application demonstrating shortcut management. It handles creating, displaying, enabling/disabling, and removing app shortcuts, including interactions with the user interface and system services.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: Main activity class for handling shortcut operations in the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and handles intent actions to add shortcuts.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Refreshes the list of shortcuts and manages instance tracking.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Removes the activity instance from tracking.

methods.name: onAddPressed
methods.description: Handles the add button press to add a new website shortcut.

methods.name: onRequestNewPinPressed
methods.description: Handles the request for creating a pinned shortcut.

methods.name: addWebSite
methods.description: Shows a dialog to input the website URL and initiates shortcut creation.

methods.name: addUriAsync
methods.description: Creates and adds the shortcut asynchronously, handles both result and non-result scenarios.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Updates the displayed list of shortcuts.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for shortcut management buttons (disable, remove, request pin).

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Generates a string describing the type of shortcut (manifest, dynamic, pinned, disabled).
